assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-arm-muscles-overlay-v1.png` (1400 x 2200, registered pixel for pixel to `hms-arm-bones-v1.png`): the deltoid over the shoulder, the biceps brachii on the front of the upper arm with its tendon to the radius just below the elbow, the triceps brachii on the back with its tendon to the point of the elbow; muscles only (the bones come from the base plate), cut cleanly just above the wrist like the base. No people, hands or faces anywhere in the image. Use the reference strictly as an invisible registration template. Output native 1001 by 1572 pixels, same canvas and same bone landmarks, no recentering, cropping or scaling. Shoulder humeral head around (420,200), elbow around (385,865). Render only deltoid, biceps, triceps and their tendons at their exact attachment sites. Make all bone pixels fully transparent, not repainted. No forearm muscle bellies. Bone base will be composited beneath this overlay.
